Ben Golliver examines 12 opening week debuts.</description><pubDate>Fri, 23 Oct 2026 11:00:40 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1022/nba-first-night-recap_16x9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Charles Barkley 'clearly didn't do his homework'</title><link>https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/50256038/charles-barkley-clearly-do-homework</link><description>Charles Barkley might want to hit the books after a seriously rough outing on Inside the NBA's 'who he play for?'</description><pubDate>Fri, 23 Oct 2026 08:26:10 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://espnmedia-cdn.akamaized.net/espn/media/common/2026/1023/dm_261023_Basketball_Highlight_Charles_Barkley_clearly_didnt_do_his_homework_20261023/dm_261023_Basketball_Highlight_Charles_Barkley_clearly_didnt_do_his_homework_20261023.jpg" /></item><item><title>Maxey, Sixers turn Philly boos into cheers in 29-point comeback over Cavaliers</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50255686/maxey-leads-charge-sixers-rally-29-stun-cavs</link><description>Booed after trailing by 24 at the half, the Sixers rode a game-high 32 points from Tyrese Maxey to erase a 29-point deficit and stun the Cavs 114-106 on Thursday.</description><pubDate>Fri, 23 Oct 2026 07:20:49 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1023/r1734920_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>Brooklyn takes on Cleveland for conference showdown</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/preview?gameId=401909854</link><description>Brooklyn Nets vs. Cleveland Cavaliers</description><pubDate>Fri, 23 Oct 2026 06:04:08 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://s.espncdn.com/stitcher/sports/basketball/nba/events/401909854.png?templateId=espn.applewatch.awayhome.1" /></item></channel></rss>
